No URL can help this node. The parent committee's page https://www.appropriations.senate.gov/ is the right check and was read on 2026-09-18 (3,318 readable chars); it carries "Defense" as a content fragment in its subcommittee list. But uncheckable_reason refuses the one-word curated name "Defense" as name_too_generic before any page is fetched, and evidence.json already records this node not_checkable / name_too_generic. Renaming to the fuller form ("Subcommittee on Defense") clears that floor -- uncheckable_reason returns None for it -- but the page's own label is the bare word "Defense" and the committee fold refuses a one-token core, so it would still not confirm from this page. A curated-name matter for CURATION.md, not a nomination.
